answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened at and to Gath: the ark's plague, David's stay there, and its capture.

clauses.english: was struck with a very great destruction when the ark of God was carried there
clauses.quote: the hand of the LORD was against the city with a very great destruction

clauses.english: was where David fled from Saul and dwelt with King Achish and his men
clauses.quote: David dwelt with Achish at Gath

clauses.english: was taken by David from the Philistines
clauses.quote: took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines

doubts: Left out the verses that only name Goliath or the giants of Gath, the Gittites, and Gath in lists or warnings (1SA 17, 2SA 21, 1CH 20, 2SA 15, 1SA 6:17, 2SA 1:20, AMO 6:2, MIC 1:10, 2CH 11:8, 1SA 7:14, JOS 11:22, JOS 13:3).
Hazael's capture (2KI 12:17) and Uzziah's breaking of the wall (2CH 26:6) are real events but were left out to keep the line short.
The Gath of the Psalm 56 title, and the time of David's stay there, may differ from the one in 1SA 27.
